```{r}
source("R/helpers.R")
statutes <- load_statutes()
edges    <- load_edges()
members  <- load_members()
units    <- load_units()
cases    <- load_cases()
insts    <- load_institutions()
```

```{r}
#| results: asis
# one chip per domain, linking to the filtered list below
counts <- statutes |>
  dplyr::count(domain, domain_name, domain_label) |>
  dplyr::arrange(match(domain, names(domain_labels)))

chips <- paste0(
  "<button type=\"button\" class=\"domain-chip domain-", counts$domain,
  "\" data-category=\"", counts$domain_name, "\" title=\"", counts$domain_label, "\">",
  "<span class=\"chip-count\">", counts$n, "</span> ", counts$domain_label, "</button>"
)

cat("<div class=\"domain-chips\">", chips,
    "<button type=\"button\" class=\"domain-chip chip-clear\" data-category=\"\">Show all</button>",
    "</div>", sep = "\n")
cat(
  "\n", nrow(statutes), " statutes, ", nrow(cases), " [Supreme Court cases](cases/index.qmd), ", nrow(edges), " recorded connections, ",
  length(units), " [study units](study/index.qmd), ", length(insts), " entries in [Who's who](whos-who.qmd), and ",
  length(members), " [member lenses](members/index.qmd). ",
  "Every statute and case links to its official text; the [Sources](sources.qmd) page lists everything the wiki draws on.\n",
  sep = ""
)
```

::: {.start-here}
**Need a specific law?** Filter the list below or use the search in the top bar. Each statute page gives the bottom line, key provisions with citations, current status and when it was last checked, the cases that interpreted it, who funds and runs it, and links to the official text.

**New to the portfolio?** The [study guide](study/index.qmd) walks through the field in twelve units, from the Constitution to single code sections, with key terms and Issues for Congress. [Who's who](whos-who.qmd) decodes the committees and agencies, and the [knowledge graph](graph.qmd) shows how everything connects.
:::

## All statutes

Type in the filter box to search titles and citations, click a column to sort, or pick a category to narrow by domain, status, layer, or U.S. Code title. The search icon in the top bar searches the full text of every page. Links to repealed and superseded laws are marked with a dagger (†).

<label class="inline-toggle"><input type="checkbox" data-wiki-toggle> Show current law only (hide repealed and superseded). The same switch is in the top bar and applies across the site.</label>

::: {#statute-list}
:::

```{=html}
<script>
// a domain chip clicks the matching entry in the Categories list; "Show all" clicks All
document.querySelectorAll(".domain-chip").forEach(function (chip) {
  chip.addEventListener("click", function () {
    var wanted = chip.dataset.category;
    document.querySelectorAll(".quarto-listing-category .category").forEach(function (el) {
      // category text reads like "War powers (19)"
      var name = el.textContent.trim().replace(/\s*\(\d+\)$/, "");
      if (wanted === "" ? name === "All" : name === wanted) {
        el.click();
      }
    });
    document.querySelectorAll(".domain-chip").forEach(function (c) { c.classList.toggle("active", c === chip && wanted !== ""); });
    document.getElementById("all-statutes").scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth" });
  });
});
</script>
```
